scope: Defines shared SignalAhead internal contracts and synthetic replay fixtures for server/Flutter implementation. This is not a live provider adapter, production policy approval, or real-road pilot validation.

contractDecisions.identity: Provider-scoped intersectionKey is required. National sourceIntersectionId preserves stdgCd + ':' + crsrdId; raw crsrdId alone is rejected for national data.
contractDecisions.movement: Allowed movements are straight, left, uturn, bus, bicycle, pedestrian. Initial operational enablement is limited to reviewed straight approaches.
contractDecisions.signalState: Allowed signal states are green, yellow, red, flashing, unknown. Unknown is never treated as green.
contractDecisions.time: UTC times and durations are integer milliseconds. 0 is valid and distinct from null. Negative values and sentinel encodings are rejected.
contractDecisions.location: LocationSample keeps nullable speed/course values. Missing speed/course must not be converted to 0 or north.
contractDecisions.prediction: PredictionResult separates status from signal freshness/color and uses reason codes including TIMING_UNVERIFIED, SIGNAL_NOT_GREEN, LOCATION_INVALID, TARGET_AMBIGUOUS and POLICY_UNCALIBRATED.
contractDecisions.policy: PredictionPolicy is versioned and must be approvedForOperation before possible predictions are accepted. Synthetic policy is separate from product defaults.

goldenFixtureCoverage: remainingAtSourceMs=0 treated as exhausted interval, not null
sourceTimeKind=unknown cannot start a fresh source countdown
same local source ID from another provider yields TARGET_AMBIGUOUS for national target
negative time and missing unit evidence are rejection cases

verification.jsonTool: contracts and golden replay fixture parsed with .venv/bin/python -m json.tool
verification.validator: .venv/bin/python tools/contract-check/validate_replay.py --input fixtures/replay/golden-contract.json => status ok, 8 scenarios, 4 negative cases
verification.secretScan: Configured credential/token pattern scan found no matches in contracts, fixtures/replay or tools/contract-check.

boundaries: No Flutter or server runtime exists in this repository yet, so shared use is represented by one checked-in golden fixture and a runtime-independent validator.
Synthetic fixtures do not satisfy SA-02 real pilot geometry requirements.
Provider timing units still require provider-profile evidence before live operation.
Product default prediction policy remains unapproved until measured field evidence is supplied.
